title: OutlineRequest
description: The 'request' part of an 'outline-holds' job (runner protocol 1.2; part 'photo', one image). Seeds are HoldSeed: centre and radius as fractions of the photo (EXIF orientation applied), radius of the LONGER side.

options.description: Outliner options; unknown keys are ignored.

id.description: Echoed in the result; unique within the job.

boxWidth.description: Detector box width as a fraction of the photo width; with boxHeight the box replaces the radius square.
